ns2:course.label: Adv Studies in Crop Sciences
ns2:course.description: Directed studies of selected problems or topics relevant to Crop Sciences. Study may be in one of the following fields: 1) Plant Breeding and Genetics; 2) Plant Molecular Biology; 3) Plant Physiology; 4) Crop Production and Ecology; 5) Biometrics; 6) Plant Pathology; 7) Entomology; and 8) Weed Science. May be repeated up to 4 hours in the same term and to a maximum of 12 hours in separate terms, if topics vary. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
